label: Volcano by Viewing Ledge
literalRoomDescription: You are high above the floor of the volcano. The rim of the volcano looks very narrow and you are very near it. To the east is what appears to be a viewing ledge, too thin to land on.
safeSceneProfile: Volcano airborne band 3. No standing floor: player support comes from the source balloon, not invisible platforms. Preserve source-described elevation and ledge visibility without adding landings; only band 4 explicitly opens to sky.
